Package persistence

Class CtrlAnswerQuestion

java.lang.Object
persistence.CtrlAnswerQuestion
public class CtrlAnswerQuestion extends Object
The CtrlAnswerQuestion class is responsible for controlling persistence-related operations on the classes Answer and AnswerToQuestion. It's intended to be called by the controller of the persistence. Stores Answers and AnswersToQuestion in memory and disk through the Cache. This class follows the singleton pattern. The CtrlAnswerQuestion::close() method needs to be run manually **before** this class is destructed.
Author:
Artur Leivar (artur.leivar@estudiantat.upc.edu)
